# LibControl

> Best AI library growth software for reading halls and study centres in India — free trial available.

LibControl is an affordable, professional library management system with AI tools for seat tracking, fee management, student register, digital attendance, scheduling, multi-branch operations, mobile access, and business growth. Operated and marketed by Katsindia.

## Product

- [Home](https://libcontrol.in/): Main product site with features, modules, pricing, and growth services
- [Free trial](https://libcontrol.in/try): Start a free 14-day trial of LibControl
- [Live demo](https://demo.libcontrol.in/admin/login): Explore the LibControl admin demo online
- [Documentation](https://libcontrol.in/documentation.html): Product guides and how-to documentation
- [Support articles](https://libcontrol.in/support-articles.html): Help centre articles for library owners

## What LibControl does

- Multi-branch library management from one platform
- Live seat maps, trial seats, and occupancy tracking
- Student registry, fees, renewals, and expiry reminders
- Enquiries, WhatsApp-friendly contact flows, and growth tooling
- AI insights and business reports for smarter decisions
- Optional Grow My Library marketing packages (WhatsApp, Google Business, SEO, ads, reviews)

## Plans

- Starter: up to 35 seats, 1 hall, 1 branch
- Pro: up to 100 seats, 3 halls, 2 branches
- Custom: larger libraries, custom features, and workflows
- Prices are shown on the website and exclude GST
